landing.heroSubtitle: A topology management platform built for warehouse and logistics IT departments. Design network maps, track every device and IP, and share live infrastructure views with your clients — all in one place.
landing.featuresSubtitle: From first cable to full infrastructure overview — manage your warehouse network with confidence.
landing.featureMapsDescription: Visualize your entire warehouse network on an interactive map. Place devices, draw connections, and navigate your infrastructure at a glance.
landing.featureDeviceDescription: Track every device's IP address, type, location, and notes in one place. Quickly find and identify any asset in your network.
landing.featureRackDescription: Model rack cabinets and workstations with detailed slot-level views. Know exactly what's installed where at all times.
landing.featureClientDescription: Assign topologies to one or more client organizations. Each client sees only their own infrastructure — fully isolated and secure.
landing.featurePdfDescription: Export any topology as a high-quality PDF for documentation, audits, or offline sharing with your team.
landing.featureSecurityDescription: Granular permissions for admins, managers, technicians, and client users. Everyone sees exactly what they need — nothing more.
landing.howTitle: From blueprint to client in three steps
landing.howSubtitle: The workflow is designed for field engineers and the companies they serve.
landing.howStep1Description: Your staff open the editor, upload a floor blueprint, and drag devices, servers, and cables onto the map.
landing.howStep2Description: Once the topology is ready, assign it to the relevant warehouse or logistics company with a single click.
landing.howStep3Description: The client's IT department logs in and instantly sees their live topology — devices, IPs, notes, and rack details.
landing.platformDescription: FieldDesk is purpose-built for the security and IT needs of warehouse and logistics operators. It replaces static diagrams and spreadsheets with a live, shared view of your network.
landing.platformPoint1: Drag-and-drop topology editor with floor blueprint overlay
landing.platformPoint2: Device palette: cameras, servers, switches, access points, sockets
landing.platformPoint3: Rack cabinet detail view with slot-level management
landing.platformPoint4: Connection lines with port numbers and cable types
landing.platformPoint5: IP address and notes per device
landing.platformPoint6: One-click PDF export for audits and documentation
landing.cardTopologyViewerDesc: Interactive map with live device positions
landing.cardDeviceRegistryDesc: IP, type, notes and rotation per asset
landing.cardClientPortalDesc: Read-only view for each client org
landing.footerTagline: Network topology management platform for the warehouse and logistics sector.
